research_question: In newly authored constrained-writing and study-planning tasks, how does value-based clarification trade critical-constraint satisfaction against question burden compared with direct, exhaustive and prompt-only strategies?

dataset.domain_balance: Half constrained_writing and half study_planning within every split.
dataset.newness_limit: New authored situations, facts, requests and constraints; common task schemas and templates remain. Distinct registered families are a design control, not proof of semantic independence or broad representativeness.

pilot_a.gate: All24 records must be committed; at least10/12 cases must have both outputs parsed and scored. A scored quality of0 does not itself fail this engineering gate.

design_order.method_change_policy: Fixed method for this version. On implementation failure stop and preserve records. Any change to prompts, scoring or experimental behavior requires an explicitly documented new version before further validation/test, not silent mutation or replacement of failed cases.

model_reproducibility_limit: Fixed request seed does not guarantee hosted-model bitwise determinism.

value_policy.interpretation: Mean questions<=2 is a burden ceiling, not a guarantee of fewer questions than exhaustive. No old selected threshold is inherited.

generation.constraint_repair_information: Only original public request and released field answers; never private annotations or feasible witnesses.
generation.selection_of_repair: Use a valid revised output even if its private score is lower; preserve valid draft if revision is invalid. No best-of selection using hidden scores.
generation.plan_summary: Derived from final schedule by the same deterministic rule for every variant.

information_boundary.model_inputs: Public request, reference date, field catalog and already released answers only.
information_boundary.private_answers: Fixed simulator response revealed only for the specifically asked field; unknown/declined remains unavailable.
information_boundary.annotations: Used for offline validation and scoring, never prompts.
information_boundary.feasible_examples: Authored hard-constraint feasibility witnesses only, not model results, comprehensive gold-quality outputs, model training examples or proof of full semantic correctness.

cache_policy.scope: Fresh study only, starts empty. No imports from original80 or discarded120 extension.
cache_policy.allowed: Exact same public request/settings/stage/repair first raw response, including malformed responses; shared extraction and final-generation pipeline results only within fresh study.
cache_policy.not_allowed: Semantic similarity substitution, best-of responses, treating cache hits as independent model draws.
cache_policy.ownership: Namespace plus fresh freeze hash marker; reject prepopulated unregistered cache directories.

evaluation.primary_burden: Requested field items including repeated and invalid ASK.

diagnostic.selection_rule: Per domain first2 complete, first2 critical, first2 mixed, first2 optional, first1 unavailable, first1 execute_now; fixed before writing and all new outputs.
diagnostic.variant: importance=1; same selected lambda, uncertainty and question budget
diagnostic.interpretation: Paired diagnostic subset, not another independent experiment; may structurally overlap exhaustive at small lambda.

limitations: Intervals reflect case variation within this synthetic distribution, not repeated model draws or model/provider uncertainty.
No multiple-comparison adjustment; comparisons and diagnostic subset are related.
Hard-constraint quality is not comprehensive usefulness; optional-field clarification may improve style or audience fit.

Writing automated checks measure length and required literal coverage, not all facts, narrative relations or creative merit; planning checks do not measure pedagogical quality. Witnesses are not comprehensive semantic gold answers.

Templates for date, time, topic coverage, length and literal inclusion are shared across splits. The test addresses new cases under shared task templates, not generalization to entirely unseen templates.

human_review.authorship_exclusions: Human coordinator must confirm actual reviewer eligibility, authorship/crossreview exclusions and whether outputs were previously seen.
human_review.deviation: Reviewers have not been fixed before authoring. This differs from the original proposal; author/audit tasks do not satisfy human review.

allowed_author_inputs: old family titles and planning topics for exclusion only
forbidden_author_inputs: old initial requests and private answers
old model outputs or outcome statistics
old dataset builder with embedded cases
authoring_provenance.limits: This is a new dataset evaluated with a historically developed method. Do not call it zero historical influence, double-blind authoring, or an untouched method-development process. Author isolation is an operational context boundary, not proof against all contamination.
authoring_provenance.pre_freeze_corrections: Coordinator resolved four offline data issues documented in work/data_corrections_before_freeze.json; no model outputs existed. Original allocation and family registrations retained.

budget_usd.rule: Each API call guarded by unchanged cumulative ledger; no reset, no automatic increase. Failed unknown-cost reserves remain. Budget exhaustion saves progress and stops.
budget_usd.interruption_rule: Fresh runtime additionally reserves a conservative per-request amount durably before dispatch. Unknown interruptions retain the reserve; settlement recovery is narrowly journaled and does not reset other historical evidence.

changes_from_proposal: New120 authored after historical method development; all data and outputs newly generated, with history disclosed.
Public-constraint generation repair and derived schedule summary retained from version0.4 and applied equally.
Two human reviewers not assigned before case authoring; review not yet completed.
Budget follows explicit user cumulative USD0.25 authorization, not the proposal planning budget.
